title: Lawyers protest in Lucknow over Advocates Protection Act, other demands

ai.summary: Lawyers in Lucknow breached police barricades to stage a sit-in near the Assembly gate demanding eight points, including implementation of the Uttar Pradesh Advocates Protection Act and increased Advocate Welfare Fund.

facts.claim: Lawyers in Lucknow breached police barricades to stage a sit-in near the Assembly gate
facts.quote: Advocates breach barricades, stage a sit-in near Assembly gate; warn of a massive stir if their demands are not met within 15 days

facts.claim: Lawyers demanded implementation of the Uttar Pradesh Advocates Protection Act
facts.quote: Their first demand is immediate implementation of the Uttar Pradesh Advocates Protection Act

facts.claim: Lawyers demanded increased Advocate Welfare Fund from ₹5 lakh to ₹25 lakh
facts.quote: They demands include an increase in the Advocate Welfare Fund amount from ₹5 lakh to ₹25 lakh

facts.claim: Lawyers demanded installation of CCTV cameras in all district courts within a month
facts.quote: Another key demand is installation of CCTV cameras in courtrooms of all district courts across Uttar Pradesh within a month

ai.background_note: Lawyers in Uttar Pradesh are demanding implementation of the Uttar Pradesh Advocates Protection Act and other reforms, following a joint meeting of the Central Bar Association and Lucknow Bar Association.
